Senior Backend Engineer

Company: Atlas Platform
Employment type: Permanent Full time
Location: Auckland

What This Role Does
- Design and build scalable backend services and REST APIs.
- Lead technical delivery for Node.js services in AWS.
- Improve system reliability, observability, testing, and deployment practices.

Qualifications
- Proven experience building production backend systems.
- Strong skills in Node.js, SQL, AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management.
- Experience mentoring engineers and leading delivery.

Benefits
